Claro, como qualquer um que foi jovem na década passada também eu sucumbi à hipnose do Facebook e ainda tenho conta nessa rede social, mas confesso que há meses que não vou lá e não passo lá muito tempo.

If you enjoy reading my Spoiler-Free reviews, please follow my blog @ Here we go with the fourth review of a David Fincher's film this week, in preparation for the upcoming Mank, directed by the same person who delivered phenomenal movies like Se7en, Fight Club, Zodiac, and more.

You have to wonder whether Mark Zuckerberg would ever have liked this career defining portrayal by Jesse Eisenberg? His character comes across as an arrogant ass of a man who is prepared to chuck just about everyone under the bus in order to get his original concept of an inter-connected network that enables folk to chat with each other in real time online.
